ja.title: DLL3を補う標的としてB7-H3とSEZ6を比べる
ja.summary: SCLCの公開共発現表から、DLL3へB7-H3・SEZ6を加えた追加被覆率を標本別に計算。二つのコホートで順位と不確実性を比較し、RNA検出と薬効の違いを整理する。
ja.seo_title: DLL3・B7-H3・SEZ6の標本別追加被覆率
ja.seo_description: SCLCの公開共発現表を再解析。DLL3にB7-H3とSEZ6を追加したRNA被覆率を標本別に比較し、順位の不確実性とタンパク質・薬効へ外挿できない範囲を示す。

en.title: Comparing B7-H3 and SEZ6 as additional targets alongside DLL3
en.summary: Reanalysis of public SCLC coexpression tables compares additional RNA coverage from B7-H3 and SEZ6 across samples and cohorts, with bootstrap uncertainty and no protein or efficacy inference.
en.seo_title: DLL3, B7-H3 and SEZ6: sample-specific RNA coverage
en.seo_description: Reanalysis of public SCLC coexpression tables: additional DLL3 RNA coverage from B7-H3 or SEZ6 by sample, with bootstrap uncertainty and no efficacy inference.

english.title: Comparing B7-H3 and SEZ6 as additional targets alongside DLL3
english.summary: Sample-level reanalysis of published SCLC coexpression fractions. Additional RNA-detection coverage and resampling uncertainty are compared across two cohorts without inferring protein density or drug efficacy.
